chinese: 尊敬的各位领导、各位来宾：大家好！
pinyin: Zūnjìng de gèwèi língdǎo, gèwèi láibīn: dàjiā hǎo!
english: Distinguished leaders and guests, hello everyone!

chinese: 我叫张居信，是张学良将军的孙子。
pinyin: Wǒ jiào Zhāng Jūxìn, shì Zhāng Xuéliáng jiāngjūn de sūnzi.
english: My name is Zhang Juxin. I am General Zhang Xueliang's grandson.

chinese: 感谢主办方邀请我来到北京。
pinyin: Gǎnxiè zhǔbànfāng yāoqǐng wǒ láidào Běijīng.
english: Thank you to the hosts for inviting me to Beijing.

chinese: 九十年前，我的祖父和杨虎城将军，为了停止内战、一致抗日，发动了西安事变。
pinyin: Jiǔshí nián qián, wǒ de zǔfù hé Yáng Hǔchéng jiāngjūn, wèile tíngzhǐ nèizhàn, yízhì kàng Rì, fādòng le Xī'ān Shìbiàn.
english: Ninety years ago, my grandfather and General Yang Hucheng launched the Xi'an Incident to end the civil war and unite against Japan.

chinese: 此后，他失去自由五十多年。
pinyin: Cǐhòu, tā shīqù zìyóu wǔshí duō nián.
english: Afterward, he lost his freedom for more than fifty years.

chinese: 我的祖母赵一荻，一直陪在他身边。
pinyin: Wǒ de zǔmǔ Zhào Yīdí, yìzhí péi zài tā shēnbiān.
english: My grandmother Zhao Yidi was always by his side.

chinese: 我从一岁起，每年都去台湾看望祖父。
pinyin: Wǒ cóng yí suì qǐ, měinián dōu qù Táiwān kànwàng zǔfù.
english: From the age of one, I visited my grandfather in Taiwan every year.

chinese: 他失去了那么多，可是我从来没有看到他有一点怨恨。
pinyin: Tā shīqù le nàme duō, kěshì wǒ cónglái méiyǒu kàndào tā yǒu yìdiǎn yuànhèn.
english: He had lost so much, yet I never once saw him bitter.

chinese: 后来我明白了。祖父九十岁时说过：做事情，要问心无愧。
pinyin: Hòulái wǒ míngbai le. Zǔfù jiǔshí suì shí shuō guo: zuò shìqing, yào wèn xīn wú kuì.
english: Later I understood. At ninety, my grandfather said: in whatever you do, keep a clear conscience.

chinese: 因为他心里想的，不是自己，而是国家和同胞。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā xīnlǐ xiǎng de, bú shì zìjǐ, ér shì guójiā hé tóngbāo.
english: Because what was in his heart was not himself, but his country and his people.

chinese: 我们不能忘记这样的爱国将领。
pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng wàngjì zhèyàng de àiguó jiànglǐng.
english: We must not forget patriotic generals like him.

chinese: 也要让下一代记住这段历史。
pinyin: Yě yào ràng xià yí dài jìzhù zhè duàn lìshǐ.
english: And we must let the next generation remember this history.

chinese: 愿中华民族团结、和平、繁荣！谢谢大家！
pinyin: Yuàn Zhōnghuá mínzú tuánjié, hépíng, fánróng! Xièxie dàjiā!
english: May the Chinese nation be united, peaceful, and prosperous! Thank you all!
